title_zh: 厦门港：海峡两岸的重要口岸
title_en: China's Ports (7/20): Xiamen, a Key Port Facing the Taiwan Strait
note_en: 由于 introduces a cause and, unlike 因为…所以…, usually needs no partner word in the second half: 由于靠近台湾，厦门港在两岸经济交流中扮演着特殊的角色 "Because it is close to Taiwan, Xiamen plays a special role." 由于 is more formal than 因为 and is often followed by a short verb or noun phrase rather than a full clause, much like English "due to" or "owing to" at the start of a sentence.
